# Atelier Dufour

> Atelier Dufour is an art studio in Biel/Bienne, Switzerland, run by Manuela
> Maurer. It offers integrales Gestalten with Tonerde INTON®, Ausdrucksmalen
> (expressive painting), an open studio, and creative workshops for children
> and young people.

Atelier Dufour is the studio of Manuela Maurer, Künstlerin und Kunsttherapeutin
i.A. Work centres on process-oriented, non-judgemental creative practice:
working with Tonerde INTON® clay, expressive painting at a large wall, and
workshops that let children and young people experiment with different
materials and techniques. The studio also shows the exhibition project
"Schaufenster" with artist Martina Baldinger, and shares a holiday house in the
Gantrisch region.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://atelierdufour.ch/): Overview of the studio's offers, current open-door dates, and contact.
- [Workshops](https://atelierdufour.ch/workshops): Creative workshops for children and young people.
- [Integrales Gestalten mit Tonerde INTON®](https://atelierdufour.ch/ton): Work with INTON® clay.
- [Ausdrucksmalen](https://atelierdufour.ch/malen): Expressive painting at a large wall.
- [Schatten](https://atelierdufour.ch/schatten): Slideshow on the theme "Schatten".
- [Schaufenster](https://atelierdufour.ch/fenster): Exhibition project with Martina Baldinger.
- [Ferienhaus](https://atelierdufour.ch/ferienhaus): Holiday house in the Gantrisch area.
- [Über mich](https://atelierdufour.ch/ueber-mich): About Manuela Maurer.
- [Kontakt](https://atelierdufour.ch/kontakt): Contact and visit.

## Workshops
- [Offenes Atelier](https://atelierdufour.ch/workshop/offenes-atelier): Open studio for ages 8 and up.
- [Pappmaché](https://atelierdufour.ch/workshop/pappmache): Modelling with papier-mâché.
- [Schoggi giessen](https://atelierdufour.ch/workshop/schoggi-giessen): Casting and decorating chocolate.
- [Siebdruck](https://atelierdufour.ch/workshop/siebdruck): Screen printing on fabric or paper.
